Talent0_2Ability.name: Thirst for Knowledge
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When self's HP is full, AP Regen per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Thirst for Knowledge
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
When HP is full, AP Regen per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.
When attacking with a Tactical Weapon, for each <color=#F74848>1</color> AP that you possess, Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+3%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>15%</color>.

400001.name: Strategic Bombing 1
400001.SpecificEffects: When a Tactical Weapon runs out of ammo, trigger <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf>. This process takes <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

700016.name: Precision Strike
700016.describe: Uses Missile Launcher to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>2.0x</color> DMG to the hit part and no longer dealing Splash DMG.

400203.name: Killing Returns
400203.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part with a Missile, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

700024.name: Graphite Warhead
700024.describe: Uses Rocket Launcher to attack all targets within a <range type=1>3*3 tile area</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.25x</color> AoE DMG. After combat, inflict <buf ID=3006502>[Short Circuit I]</buf> on the targets hit, effective <color=#F74848>1</color> time.

400205.name: AP Planning
400205.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Rocket Launcher, if <color=#F74848>3</color> or more targets are hit, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective for <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

400206.name: New Initiatives
400206.describe: Fully restore Tactical Weapon Ammo and gain <buf ID=4002062>[Missile DMG UP]</buf> and <buf ID=4002065>[Rocket DMG UP]</buf>, with each buff effective for <color=#F74848>1</color> time. Can continue the action with the remaining movement.

400208.name: Scorched Earth
400208.describe: When both shoulders are equipped with the same category of Tactical Weapon, cast <buf ID=900016>[Salvo]</buf> code to attack.

400031.name: Indiscriminate 1
400031.SpecificEffects: After the first attack with a Tactical Weapon each turn, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, with Final DMG <color=#F74848>-30%</color>, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

400033.name: Strategic Bombing 4
400033.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf> is complete, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

400034.name: Indiscriminate 2
400034.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Tactical Weapon for the first time each turn, for every <color=#F74848>1</color> AP cost, DMG <color=#F74848>+4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

400035.name: Indiscriminate 3
400035.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> is triggered, allow continued moving with the remaining movement.

400036.name: Indiscriminate 4
400036.SpecificEffects: After triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, it no longer reduces final damage.

400241.name: Path to the Truth 1
400241.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, restore <color=#F74848>10%</color> of HP.

400043.name: Power Innovation 3
400043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

400244.name: Path to the Truth 2
400244.SpecificEffects: When HP is full, DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-20%</color>.

400245.name: Path to the Truth 3
400245.SpecificEffects: When receiving active repairs, Received Repair AMT <color=#F74848>+12%</color>.

400246.name: Path to the Truth 4
400246.SpecificEffects: The HP required for <buf ID=4002501>[Thirst for Knowledge]</buf> to take effect has been lowered to <color=#F74848>70%</color>.
